reviews.comment: Such an easy A for BICH/GENE majors who need this class. All you need for an A is to show up to class (only once a week) and do the graded assignments (there were only like 5). Very kind and knowledgeable guy and he really doesn't take this class seriously at all.

EASY A!!! He basically tells you at the start of his course that if you come to class and you do every assignment you'll get an A. One big group project is most of your grade so make sure you put in effort. -1% off your grade for every class you miss. He's not the most tech savvy so attendance is through a clipboard passed around during class/
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof Mullet was very nice and more interested in discussion than busy work. Had some trouble with the technology, but he had a TA who helped him out with it. Would definitely take again, he had some good advice.
